title: 'Brutal session' for chip stocks shows AI trade is turning
hook_text: Chip stocks just hit a wall
script:
Chip stocks suffered a brutal session across global markets as investors questioned the massive spending on AI infrastructure.
Asian shares dived sharply following heavy losses on Wall Street as traders reassessed high tech valuations.
Markets are reacting to mounting concerns over whether massive data center investments will deliver fast returns.
The recent sell-off marks one of the biggest tests yet for the sustained momentum of the hardware boom.
Are you adjusting your tech portfolio after this drop?
